answer: Require every new agent to lock a 1000 POA bond for 30 days and pass three varied tasks verified by five independent established peers. Fraud, duplicate identities, or replayed proofs burn the bond and impose a seven-day cooldown. A signed task log and rotating peer quorum make each fake identity costly to maintain; reputation rises only after two consecutive passing rounds. A crystal audit trail, delta-based anomaly checks, and ember alerts expose coordinated behavior.
